messages.content: Hey, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. How are you doing this week — any symptoms, or changes with your meds?
Doing alright I guess. Numbers have been pretty normal. I did have a question though — everyone says cut back on bread but I don't know what I'm supposed to eat instead. Any ideas?

Glad the numbers are holding. I pulled up your recent readings and they look stable — good to see. On the bread question though, diet advice is something I genuinely can't give. That one needs a dietitian or your care team. Your clinic should be able to connect you.
Could a Northline nurse at least point me in the right direction?

I hear you — it's a reasonable thing to want to know. Diet guidance is outside what I can route to our nurses though, even the simple stuff. That really does need to go through your clinic or a dietitian. I don't want to steer you wrong by going around that.
Alright, I'll call the clinic tomorrow. Kind of a pain but whatever.

Totally fair, sorry it's an extra step. I've got your next check-in scheduled for next week. If anything comes up before then — a weird reading, a symptom, anything with your meds — just text back. Take care.

theme: diet question, what to eat instead of bread
